governance.hyperparameters_selected_on: purged chronological 80/20 split within Train only

null.selection: seed-0 random incoming edges; per-target counts match aligned real E_i

training.optimizer: Adam with explicit L2 penalty from the frozen weight_decay grid
training.phase6a: hidden=64, ReLU, dropout=0.1, train-only feature/target standardization
training.phase6b: raw frozen-dynamics activity means; only active Δ edges and linear heads train; Δ L2

phase6b_consistency_check.method: initial W_ij-weighted upstream mean activity versus frozen Phase 5 DN readout; diagnostic only

primary_metric.name: spearman_ic
primary_metric.description: Validation set primary target Spearman IC minimum threshold

min_practical_effect.description: Minimum practical effect size; statistical significance alone is insufficient

min_practical_effect_balanced_acc.description: Minimum practical effect for balanced accuracy over 0.5/majority baseline (+0.02)

seeds_agreement_ratio.description: Direction agreement across seeds (at least 80% seeds agree in sign)

minority_action_ratio.description: Minority action ratio >= 0.05 to avoid action collapse (§6 Phase 3)

margin_std_min.description: Minimum standard deviation of margin across samples to verify non-flat output

trading_net_return_min.description: Minimum net return after cost (must be strictly positive, >= 0.0)

trading_sharpe_min.description: Minimum strategy Sharpe ratio after cost

connectome_vs_matched_control_ic_delta_m.description: Minimum Spearman IC increment of Connectome over matched control (Random/Scramble)

connectome_vs_matched_control_p_max.description: Maximum p-value from block permutation test comparing Connectome vs matched control

connectome_vs_ohlcv_baseline_ic_delta_mi.description: Minimum Spearman IC increment of Connectome over OHLCV baseline

renderer_shortcut_r2_max.description: Maximum R^2 of margin explained by mean brightness, nonzero pixels, or renderer features

input_to_simulation_noise_variance_ratio.description: Minimum ratio of cross-input margin variance to repeated-simulation noise variance

comparisons.holm_note: available paired comparisons were adjusted over the full 12-test family; missing baseline p-values use a conservative 1.0 placeholder and remain N/A
